Welcome, and no worries—happy to help you get started.
Here’s a simple path:
Figure out your size
Use True Fit on any product page (“Find My Size”) for a personalized recommendation.
Or check our Size Guide to convert from AU/UK to US sizing and see general fit tips (boots run true to size; half sizes add width, not length).
Decide which series suits you
Originals: True-to-size, snug fit, great all‑round everyday boot.
Classics: Roomier, leather‑lined, extra footbeds for customized comfort, good for long wear.
Dress Series: Sleeker, runs long; we recommend sizing down for a refined look that can go from casual to office.
All‑Terrain: Vibram® sole, better traction and stability for mixed or rugged environments.
Thermal: Insulated and weatherproof for cold, wet conditions.
Kids’ Series: Durable pull‑on styles with removable footbeds for growing feet.
If you already own a pair
Check the AU/UK size stamped on the sole or box, then use the conversion chart in our Size Guide to find the equivalent US size.
As a rule of thumb: women’s AU/UK is 3 sizes less than US; men’s AU/UK is 1 size less than US.
Try boots in person (optional)
Use our online store locator to find retailers near you if you’d like to try on different series and sizes in person.
If you tell us how and where you plan to use your boots (city, work, hiking, winter, etc.) and whether you like a snug or roomy fit, we can narrow down the best series and size for you based on this guidance.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here are the main Blundstone boot options in simple terms:
Originals: Simple, durable everyday boots. Unlined, true to size, snug rounded toe. Good for daily wear and light outdoor use.
Classics: Like Originals but roomier and softer. Leather‑lined, more cushioning, extra insole set. Best if you want comfort and a slightly wider fit.
Dress Series: Slimmer, sharper look with a square/chisel toe and thinner sole profile. Runs long with a relaxed fit, so you typically size down. Great for office or dressier outfits.
Thermal: Winter version with insulation, wool footbeds and weatherproofing. Similar relaxed fit to Classics, ideal for cold, wet climates.
All‑Terrain: Built for tougher conditions with grippy soles for varied surfaces—good if you’re on trails or uneven ground.
Women’s High‑Top: Taller shaft Originals for more ankle coverage and a polished Chelsea look; fit is on the narrower/snug side.
Women’s High‑Top Thermal: High‑top plus full waterproofing and insulation for snow and slush.
Kids’ Series: Easy pull‑on boots for children with removable footbeds to accommodate growing feet.
For sizing overall:
We list sizes in US sizing.
Boots generally run true to size; choose a half size up if you want a wider fit.
Half sizes add width, not length.
Boots will stretch slightly across the instep, but not in length.
